ValidationRule.description: Not allow changing Price or Tax after Case Status "Waiting for Payment"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
And(
Or(ischanged( Final_Unit_Price_Adult__c ), ischanged( Final_Unit_Price_Child__c ), ischanged( Final_Unit_Price_Infant__c ), ischanged ( Final_Tax_Adult__c ), ischanged ( Final_Tax_Child__c ), ischanged ( Final_Tax_Infant__c ) ),
Text(Case_ID__r.Status )!= "New", Text(Case_ID__r.Status )!= "Ticket Sales in Progress", Text(Case_ID__r.Status )!= "Request for Ticketing", Text(Case_ID__r.Status )!= "Price Approving", Text(Case_ID__r.Status )!= "Adhoc Request Approved" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Not allow changing Price or Tax after the Case Status "Waiting for Payment"
